fields.description: Your name for this account — for example 'Nairobi — Safaricom'. This is the name that appears as a payment method at the till.
fields.label: Display name

fields.description: The payment provider for this account. The list shows the providers installed on this site; if yours is not installed yet, you can still type its key. Cannot be changed once the account is in use.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: The company whose contract this is. Cannot be changed once the account is in use.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: One currency per account — to take a second currency, add a second account. Filled in from the company, or from the ledger account if you choose one. Cannot be changed once the account is in use.
fields.label: Currency

fields.description: Test uses your provider's sandbox keys. A test account cannot be taken live on a production site. Cannot be changed once the account is in use.
fields.label: Environment

fields.description: Set for you when you take the connection live, suspend it or resume it.
fields.label: State

fields.description: Set if your provider stops accepting these credentials after go-live — for example if they were revoked. The payment method stays available at the till and the problem is reported; nothing is switched off without you.
fields.label: Failing since

fields.description: Every payment taken through this account is posted here. Required before you can go live — without it the sale cannot be posted at the till.
fields.label: Ledger account for this payment method

fields.description: The payment method created when you go live. One payment method per account.
fields.label: Mode of Payment

fields.description: One row for each value your provider asks for. Values marked secret are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
fields.label: Credential values

fields.description: Give this address to your provider so they can confirm payments back to this site. It is worked out for you and updated every time you save. A payment cannot be confirmed until this site can be reached at this address, and you will be told if it cannot.
fields.label: Callback URL

lede: A payment provider account of the retailer's company: its provider, currency, test or live, and whether it is working.
name: Payment Account

fields.description: The name your provider uses for this value. It must match exactly.
fields.label: Field

fields.description: Secret values are stored encrypted and are never shown again — not on screen, in a test result, in an error message, or in an export.
fields.label: Secret

fields.description: For values that are not secret, such as a merchant id or an account number. Leave empty on a secret row.
fields.label: Value

fields.description: Stored encrypted, and masked whenever it is read back.
fields.label: Secret value
